goal: Attempt >=90% for each model while retaining the required model families and BN limits
selection: Validation macro F1, accuracy secondary; only original training split may be read during exploration
forbidden: model ensembles replacing the required models
BN more than 12 features or more than 5 states
bn_families: normalized regional gray densities plus topology
graph: Fixed four length-three feature chains; all nodes additionally have Y as a parent, no learned or searched edges
preprocessing: with and without deterministic moment deskew
reporting: Preserve the preceding report and all numerical results. Publish achieved accuracy truthfully, even if 90% cannot be reached.
